    (AlgHom.range.{u_1, max u_1 u_2, max u_1 u_2} (Etingof.Theorem5_18_2.universalEnvelopingToEnd.{u_1, u_2} k V n))

source_text: The centralizer of the symmetric-group action on V tensor n is exactly the image of the universal enveloping algebra under the diagonal Lie action.
